capabilities: List related notes in a side panel
Surface notes with different titles but similar content
Search notes and paragraphs by meaning
Show how far paragraphs drift from the note title
disambiguation: Not a social or networking tool; 'connections' here means semantic similarity between notes.
extras: Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux); needs the bge-m3 model (~1.2 GB) and Ollama running while indexing or searching; index stored as vectors.bin in the plugin folder; most code was written with AI.
motivation: A similar popular plugin kept freezing the author's MacBook and forcing a reboot after about ten minutes of writing, so they wrote their own free, minimalist, fully local version.
problem: Obsidian's search and links only surface notes that share words or explicit links, so related notes written in different language stay hidden.

relations.evidence: Ollama, running on the same computer, with the bge-m3 model downloaded

summary: Side panel that finds related notes, matching paragraphs and similar-content pairs using a local Ollama embedding model.
